reading_note: The teaching describes how the complete circuit of states of self-love (twelve zodia) and the five governing affections within them (five planets) are drawn from the five modes of evil-and-falsity (five worlds of Darkness) and bound by the operative Divine power (the Great Artisan/Living Spirit) into a fixed cyclic order (the sphere) within the natural-rational mind. The arc: question of cosmic ordering → answer that all hellish loves are adversaries to each other, yet are bound together by the Lord's providence into ordered cycles ruled by stewards; they were taken two per world of Darkness; the five planets correspond to the five degrees; the Sun and Moon (celestial good and spiritual truth) are not native to this dominion but are reckoned in for the sake of the economy of redemption — that the work of light may be done within the very system of darkness. When various sides of the zodiac are activated, corresponding afflictions strike the affections (cattle), the works (fruits), the natural truths (waters), and the human form itself.
